technique_name: Give three advantages of using a mobile app for business.
description: Three advantages of using a mobile app for business include increased customer engagement and loyalty, improved customer service, and increased revenue. By having a mobile app, businesses can provide more personalized content to their customers and develop more effective marketing campaigns through features like coupons and loyalty programs.
